message.uncannyencounters.crystal_frog.d: Only tamed Crystal Frogs can spar.
This challenge has expired. Select your frog and try again.
First select your own frog with a stick.
Both frogs must be adult, fully healed, idle, not breeding, and within 16 blocks; owners must be within 32 blocks. Frightened, leashed or riding frogs cannot enter.
Selected %s. Click another frog with a stick within 30 seconds, or click this frog again to deselect.
Challenge sent to %s. They have 30 seconds to accept.
%s has challenged your %s. Click your challenged frog with a stick within 30 seconds to accept.
Sparring started! The match ends when either frog reaches 25% health. Click your frog with a stick to withdraw.
Sparring cancelled. Both frogs have stopped fighting.
Sparring interrupted by outside damage or a participant leaving.
No winner after two minutes. Sparring has ended.
Frogs cannot be fed during a sparring match.
message.uncannyencounters.crystal_frog.b: Frogs cannot breed or grow through feeding while fighting or frightened.
message.uncannyencounters.frog_keeper.al: Use 1 Activated Amethyst to summon the Keeper. After both he and his Frog King die, wait 10 minutes to summon again.
message.uncannyencounters.frog_keeper.in: Select your fully healed adult frog with a stick, then use the stick on the Keeper or his Frog King. Both frogs must be in the court.
message.uncannyencounters.frog_keeper.se: His crystal armor is sealed. Defeat his Frog King in a frog duel first.
message.uncannyencounters.frog_keeper.un: The Keeper and his Frog King are neutral. Attack either and both will retaliate.
message.uncannyencounters.frog_keeper.vi: Challenge won! The Keeper and his Frog King are neutral and vulnerable. Both will retaliate if either is attacked.
message.uncannyencounters.frog_keeper.co: The Frog King is not ready. Keep the court loaded and clear its summoning space.
message.uncannyencounters.frog_keeper.al: The Keeper or his Frog King is still alive. They cannot be summoned again yet.
message.uncannyencounters.frog_keeper.co: The altar needs %s more seconds to recover.
message.uncannyencounters.frog_keeper.sp: The summoning space is blocked. Clear the floor and headroom south of the altar.

message.uncannyencounters.frog_keeper.re: The Frog King cannot return safely. Keep the court loaded and clear the floor near its original position.
message.uncannyencounters.frog_cage.own_: Only your own tamed Crystal Frogs can be caged. The Keeper's Frog King cannot be captured.
message.uncannyencounters.frog_cage.busy: This frog is fighting, frightened, breeding, riding or leashed and cannot be caged yet.
message.uncannyencounters.frog_cage.inve: There is no inventory space for the caged frog.

message.uncannyencounters.frog_cage.alre: This frog is already in the world and cannot be released twice.
message.uncannyencounters.frog_cage.bloc: There is not enough room to release the frog here.
tooltip.uncannyencounters.frog_cage.empt: Use on your own idle frog to capture it
tooltip.uncannyencounters.frog_cage.rele: Use on a clear space to release; an empty cage is returned. Timers run in a loaded breeding box.
